ambient_events: A drawer goes out, and back, and the label gets straightened.
Somebody outside on the bench pours a cup and does not drink it.
Linen comes off the boil and is hung, steaming, on the line by the window.
description: A low white building with a bench outside the door and, on the bench, a jug and two cups. Whoever is waiting is waiting out here in the sun, and somebody has thought about that.
name: The Mending Room
